reason: The command runs under shell=True, so the work is the shell's grandchild. Killing only the shell orphaned it and it held the pipes open: a 1s timeout against a 30s sleep returned after 30s while reporting a 1s timeout, and a claim command could hang CI indefinitely. Its own session is what lets _kill_tree kill the whole group (QA pass, 2026-09-11; asof.ini timeout-bug).
author: Claude
snippet: kwargs["start_new_session"] = True   # gives the shell its own group to kill
